script.title: Profit Maximisation vs Wealth Maximisation
script.caption_hook: Profit or wealth: which goal should a company really chase?

lines.say: Ma'am, profit or wealth: which goal should a company chase?
Good question! Profit maximisation means earning the highest accounting profit, mostly in the short run.
That sounds fine to me. What's wrong with more profit?
Take ₹1 lakh today or ₹1 lakh after five years. Profit alone sees them as equal.
But today's money is worth more! I can invest it.
Exactly. Profit ignores time value and risk. A risky profit looks as good as a safe one.
Then what does wealth maximisation do differently?
It maximises the market value of shareholders' equity. We discount future cash flows, and benefits must exceed cost.
So does that mean we ignore profit completely?
No. Profit is one input. Wealth maximisation judges it along with timing, risk and cash flows.
Is there an easy way to remember it?
Wealth equals T R M: Time value, Risk and Market price. Profit maximisation looks at none.
